name: Task_7
description:
Measure the 300 K reference volume of bulk Aluminum for a thermal expansion calculation. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the ASE-compatible calculator. Start with a conventional FCC unit cell of Aluminum (a = 4.05 \u00c5) and replicate it into a 3 \u00d7 3 \u00d7 3 supercell. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the isothermal-isobaric (NPT) ensemble at a target temperature of 300 K and an external pressure of 1.01325 bar. Equilibrate for at least 2 ps and retain at least 3 ps of production, extending both until temperature, volume, and pressure are settled and well sampled. Use IsotropicMTKNPT or NPTBerendsen for isotropic pressure control, choose suitable thermostat and barostat settings, and use an integration timestep no larger than 2 fs. Record at least 32 production samples spaced at most 100 fs apart, so the evaluator can derive their mean temperature, pressure, and volume.

Initialize velocities once at 300 K with a recorded seed and remove center-of-mass momentum once. Run only the 300 K reference stage, preserving the atoms, cell evolution, and momenta, and retain the calculation and restartable final state.
